tiles.summary: A grid of link tiles for navigating the vault.

badge.doc: count — the number of notes in the folder, or your own string

stats.summary: Number cards: one value per card, computed over a selection of notes.

tag.doc: tag, with or without the hash

field.doc: numeric frontmatter property; required for everything but count and streak

agg.doc: count sum avg min max latest streak

unit.doc: a suffix after the number: km, %, d.

precision.doc: decimal places, 0–6; by default a whole number stays whole and a fraction gets one decimal

notes: `streak` counts the longest run of consecutive days and `latest` takes the value from the newest note — both need YYYY-MM-DD note names.
Nothing to count — the card shows a dash rather than a zero: "no data" and "zero" are different answers.

progress.summary: Bars towards a goal: how far a number has come against a target.

goal.doc: the target to fill towards; must be above zero

tag.doc: tag, with or without the hash

field.doc: numeric frontmatter property; required for everything but count and streak

agg.doc: count sum avg min max latest streak

unit.doc: a suffix after the numbers: km, %, d.

precision.doc: decimal places, 0–6; by default a whole number stays whole and a fraction gets one decimal

notes: Going past the goal is shown as it is — 125% stays 125%; only the bar itself stops at full.
Nothing to count — the bar stays empty and the value shows a dash rather than a zero.

today.summary: A day row: today's date and links to the daily, weekly and monthly notes.

title.doc: a custom heading instead of today's date

today.example:
daily: true
weekly: true
monthly: true
notes: Takes the folder and the name format from the Periodic Notes plugin when installed; for the day it also picks up the core "Daily notes". A folder set in the Dashy settings wins over both.
With none of the keys given, only the daily note is shown. With at least one given, exactly those apply.
If the note does not exist yet the link is still drawn, dimmed: clicking it creates the note.

heatmap.summary: A year by days: one cell per day, coloured by a number from frontmatter.

tag.doc: tag, with or without the hash

color.doc: blue green cyan purple pink orange red gray, or #rrggbb

bands.doc: thresholds from the top down: [90, 80, 60] or [{min, alpha, label}]

link.doc: clicking a cell opens that day's note

title.doc: a custom heading instead of the automatic one

heatmap.example:
source: 01-Areas/Personal/Diary
field: sleep_score
color: purple
bands: [90, 80, 60]
notes: Notes must be named as YYYY-MM-DD dates — that is how the block knows which cell they belong to.
Years are taken from the data: once a new year appears, a second grid is drawn.

notInV1.table: That is Obsidian Bases. Link to a base view from a tile instead: `path: Vault.base#My view`.
notInV1.chart: That is the Obsidian Charts plugin. Dashy does not draw charts.
notInV1.tasks: That are the Tasks or Dataview plugins.
